name: HammerAI
summary: Friendly desktop and web character chat client emphasizing 100% private in-browser/Ollama local model execution with free uncensored roleplay.
ranking_rationale: Easier on-ramp to local uncensored character chat than SillyTavern + KoboldCpp, delivering privacy and free tiers without terminal tinkering.

pricing.model: Free local app + optional cloud Pro tiers
pricing.free_tier: Local desktop & free cloud chat models available free
pricing.notes: Local mode via Ollama/Desktop is free; optional cloud plans unlock hosted larger models.

pros: Clean beginner-friendly alternative to SillyTavern for private local models
Connects smoothly to local Ollama or downloadable GGUF weights
Free tier supports immediate character chat without paywall blocks
cons: Fewer advanced lorebook and prompt-engineering knobs than SillyTavern
Free cloud models have tighter context windows than paid local hardware

facts.value: Privacy-focused local & cloud character chat app
Desktop app runs models directly via Ollama with zero cloud logging
Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux clients
